description:
Revised design authorized by the user after rejecting hardcoded history flags. This description supersedes the original fixed-false history requirements and historical completion comments. Preserve useful completed reply-policy work and RAM enforcement; rework the history configuration ownership and validate the composed result.
Review must assess corrected persisted history configuration, explicit overrides, startup and refresh paths, and the web widget ownership pattern. All reopened prerequisites must pass before final review/coverage/delivery.


Functional specifications: final cross-repository review and the workflow-required
coverage-upper handoff after implementation and explicit PR review approval.
Do not run coverage phase prematurely or equate conversational design agreement
with approval of the finished code. Coordinate with zaq-973.6's delivery record.
Tests to add before implementation: none for this tracking step; coverage phase
may add targeted missing behavioral cases once review is approved.
Branches/paths validated: review all ownership boundaries, migration safety,
configuration refresh, package-default compatibility, per-connector isolation.
Mocking plan: preserve isolated production seams; no new global-mutation fixtures.
Documentation: record review, coverage exceptions, final validation and dependency
publication/pin status in Beadwork and any authorized PR description.
Action reuse assessment: not applicable; this is review/coverage coordination,
not a new executable business operation. Recheck implementation assessments.
Completion requires approved review, completed coverage handoff, required green
validation or explicitly documented unresolved blockers, and authorized reproducible
dependency delivery. Keep the epic open while required work remains.

Required policies: AGENTS.md; docs/agent-tools.md; docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md;
docs/exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md; docs/action-reuse.md; docs/testing-approach.md;
docs/services/channels.md. Read sibling AGENTS.md before sibling changes, Engine
guide before persistence work, and documentation hygiene before updating docs.
Read system-config guidance if touching encrypted fields (which should be avoided).
Preserve existing assertions. Obtain explicit approval before changing existing test
behavior; add focused tests first. No UI feature/E2E work is required by this refactor.
Commit, push, publishing dependency revisions, and merge require separate authorization.
